question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Verify row count
WITH wholesale_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(v.whsle_date, 1, 4) as calendar_year,
        vc.category_name,
        round(avg(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
        round(max(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as max_wholesale_price,
        round(min(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        round(max(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - min(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
        round(sum(v."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df v
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON v.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE substr(v.whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY substr(v.whsle_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
selling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) as calendar_year,
        vc.category_name,
        round(sum(t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * t."qty_sold(kg)"), 2) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON t.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
      AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
loss_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        round(avg(vlr."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vlr
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vlr.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    ws.calendar_year,
    ws.category_name,
    ws.avg_wholesale_price,
    ws.max_wholesale_price,
    ws.min_wholesale_price,
    ws.wholesale_price_difference,
    ws.total_wholesale_price,
    ss.total_selling_price,
    ls.avg_loss_rate,
    round(ws.total_wholesale_price * (ls.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    round(ss.total_selling_price - ws.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_stats ws
JOIN selling_stats ss ON ws.calendar_year = ss.calendar_year AND ws.category_name = ss.category_name
JOIN loss_stats ls ON ws.category_name = ls.category_name
ORDER BY ws.calendar_year, ws.category_name
